FN-SL91D57-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 183
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Sponsor: Senator Merika Coleman
Economic Development
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/02/2026
Senate Bill 183 as introduced would exempt natural hairstylists and natural hairstylist shops and
salons from licensure and regulation by the Alabama Board of Cosmetology and Barbering
which would decrease license fee receipts collected by the Board by: (1) an estimated $5,500
annually and $72,000 biannually from initial and renewal license fees no longer collected; and
(2) an undetermined amount annually and biannually from initial and renewal license fees no
longer collected from natural hair salons. This reduction in license fee receipts would be offset
by the reduction in the administrative obligations of the Board to no longer issue licenses and
inspect natural hairstylist shops and salons.

$5,500 annually and $72,000 biannually from initial and renewal license fees no longer
